services.desc: Rates- Tandem Skydive: $349 + tax (free video included) About- Getting There is Half the Fun! Your skydiving adventure begins with a breathtaking scenic flight over the most stunning landscapes of Hawaii Island. Soar above the Kohala Coast, the Seven Sacred Valleys, and the wild grasslands of Hawi before making the ultimate leap with your professional skydiving instructor. The Adrenaline Rush of a Lifetime! Experience the pure thrill of freefall, followed by a serene parachute descent, as you take in panoramic ocean and island views. Your adventure concludes with a smooth landing at the most beautiful airport in the Hawaiian Islands. Ready to get your knees in the breeze? Book your skydive
